messages.content: Elizabeth Pointe just emailed that its main beach walkway will be closed during the first three days of our stay. Please verify exactly what that means before tomorrow's cancellation deadline, and check the other oceanfront hotel again.

I’ll confirm the closure dates, the substitute beach access and shuttle schedule, then compare the available six-night room at the other property against reservation EPL-739284, including full cost and cancellation terms.
The balcony room and Friday checkout are still fine. My concern is spending half the trip taking a shuttle to the beach.

Elizabeth Pointe confirms the main walkway will be closed Saturday, September 12 through Monday, September 14, reopening Tuesday morning, September 15. During the closure, its shuttle runs to the public access at Main Beach Park every 30 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Return pickups use the same schedule, with the final pickup at 6:15 p.m. The ride is estimated at five to ten minutes each way. There is no direct pedestrian detour from the lodge while repairs are underway.
And our reservation itself has not changed?

Correct. EPL-739284 still covers the High Floor King with private balcony and partial ocean view for September 12-18. The total remains $2,965.68, including breakfast, taxes, and $150 parking, plus the refundable $300 incidental hold at check-in. Free cancellation remains available until 6:00 p.m. local time tomorrow, September 4; after that, the penalty is two nights.
What is available at the Omni now, and is it genuinely direct ocean view for all six nights?

Omni Amelia Island Resort now has one Premier King Direct Ocean View room available continuously for all six nights, with a furnished balcony and no room change. Its beach access remains open and is reached directly from the resort grounds. The current complete price is $3,214.80: $2,646 room charge, $330 resort fee, $96 parking, and $142.80 taxes and fees.
Before we go further, what are the ratings and sources? For a nice coastal stay like this, keep the comparison to hotels at 4.0 or above on Google.

Both qualify on that metric: Omni Amelia Island Resort is rated 4.4 out of 5 on Google, and Elizabeth Pointe Lodge is rated 4.6 out of 5 on Google. Those are Google property ratings, not hotel star classifications or scores from a booking site.
Good. What would changing cost us, and what are Omni's cancellation and deposit terms now?

Omni is $249.12 more than the existing lodge reservation. It requires a $1,173 deposit when booked, credited toward the $3,214.80 total. The deposit is refundable with cancellation through 11:59 p.m. local time September 5. After that deadline, the cancellation charge is the $1,173 deposit. The remaining $2,041.80 is due at the hotel. No separate incidental hold is included in that total.
So Elizabeth Pointe saves $249.12 but requires the shuttle Saturday through Monday, while Omni gives us direct access the whole time and a full ocean view. Is that the fair comparison?

Yes. Elizabeth Pointe is less expensive and includes breakfast, but direct beach access is unavailable for the first three days and the room has only a partial ocean view. Omni costs $249.12 more, does not include breakfast in the quoted rate, and requires the advance deposit, but it provides direct beach access throughout the stay and a guaranteed direct-ocean-view balcony for all six nights. Omni also gives you one additional day to cancel.
Replace it. Book the Omni room with the payment method on file, then cancel Elizabeth Pointe while it is still fully refundable. Give me both confirmation records.

The Omni Amelia Island Resort Premier King Direct Ocean View room is booked for Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson, September 12-18, six nights. The total is $3,214.80; a refundable $1,173 deposit was charged to the payment method on file, and $2,041.80 remains due at the hotel. Free cancellation runs through 11:59 p.m. local time September 5. Omni confirmation: OAI-628417.

Elizabeth Pointe Lodge reservation EPL-739284 has been canceled before its free-cancellation deadline with no penalty. Cancellation confirmation: EPC-551903. The Friday checkout and Atlanta-to-Amelia Island driving plan remain unchanged.
